messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: facet + free scales + coord flip
parts:
Hi all,

Free scales in facetting do not seem to take coord_clip into account:

set.seed(1)
d = data.frame(variable=rep(c("foo","bar"), each=10), x = 1:10, value
= c(runif(10, 1, 10), runif(10, 100, 200)))

ggplot(d, aes(x=x)) + geom_path(aes(y=value)) + coord_flip() +
facet_grid(.~variable, scales="free")
# even though, due to coord flip, the y scale is at the bottom and can
be free, it is not

# I cannot switch x and y since my ultimate goal involves geom_ribbon
ggplot(d, aes(x=x)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=value-3, ymax=value+3)) +
coord_flip() + facet_grid(.~variable, scales="free")
# and geom ribbon only takes ymin and ymax arguments (not xmin and xmax)

# So the solution is to do the facetting in the other dimension
ggplot(d, aes(x=x)) + geom_path(aes(y=value)) + facet_grid(variable~.,
scales="free")
# But the result is not really what I want (my x scale is a depth and
it would of course be nicer to have it vertical)


I'll experiment with geom polygon to try and create the ribbon
manually. That's the only solution I can see right now.
Thanks in advance for any pointer/other workarounds.

JiHO

messages.subject: Re: facet + free scales + coord flip
parts:
Yup, that's right. Free scales currently only work with
coord_cartesian. I haven't figured out all the details for how it
would work otherwise.

Hadley
